note: Hard B, root reading: base.json is null (a lineage root has no mother), so the declared difference is against the framework stock cfg -- the only base a root can have. A lineage root has no upstream mother, so what this recipe IS, is what it writes on top of that stock cfg, and this file is that statement, path by path. The gate refuses every direction: a changed path not listed here, a listed path that no longer changes, and an env path whose named author does not produce it. Rewriting this file is therefore not enough to pass -- the declaration has to agree with it.

baseline_actions.why: the deployed two-group action split (legs/spine), with the single-group term removed

baseline_base_contact.why: base contact means down, so survival has a definition

baseline_fixed_command.why: a fixed command point, with both switches that could rewrite one turned off

baseline_flat_ground.why: flat ground is the question itself: no generator, and no scanner scanning a constant

baseline_no_curriculum.why: no curriculum: the framework base's only curriculum term is removed

baseline_no_dr.why: no DR: every event the framework base registers is named and removed, and reset_base's ranges are zeroed axis by axis

baseline_proprio_obs.why: the scan observation goes with the scanner, and observation noise is a randomization, so it is off explicitly

baseline_rewards.why: seven terms: the yaw-frame kernel replaces the exp one, the belly penalty is added, five constraints are removed

baseline_robot.why: the shared frozen asset: usd, implicit-PD actuator groups, initial pose and soft limits

agent.why: The agent is a class, not a declaration: there are no elements, so these entries carry a reason and no element name. The stock cfg leaves the model and algorithm unset, so the whole of them shows up here -- listed leaf by leaf, because naming 'algorithm' as one prefix would let a field the framework adds pass as ours.

allowed.num_steps_per_env: 24 x 4 substeps = one 1.92 s rollout window at 50 Hz
allowed.max_iterations: 3000, the framework velocity-task default rather than the paper S1 recipe
allowed.experiment_name: lizard_baseline_v1: one version, one log dir (versioning.mdc A)
allowed.actor.__missing__: the whole actor model is set, where the stock leaves it unset
allowed.actor.class_name: the default MLPModel: no three-encoder split, this line has one observation group
allowed.actor.obs_normalization: off: normalization statistics are training state, and this line inherits no state
allowed.critic.__missing__: the whole critic model is set, where the stock leaves it unset
allowed.critic.obs_normalization: off, same reason as the actor
allowed.critic.distribution_cfg: null: the critic has no distribution
allowed.algorithm.__missing__: the whole algorithm block is set, where the stock leaves it unset
allowed.algorithm.num_mini_batches: 4 (the framework velocity-task value; the paper S1 recipe's 11 belongs to 4096 envs)
allowed.algorithm.gamma: 0.99, the framework task value rather than the paper's 0.996
